For weekend Chinese school teachers

Lumi Bopomofo Pro: Zhuyin practice that continues after class

Made by Lumi Studio · Guan Feng Lai, the app's developer. This is a product sheet, not a school or government document.

Weekend Chinese school meets for a few hours a week, so home practice depends on parents, and many parents do not read Zhuyin themselves. Lumi Bopomofo Pro is the complete Zhuyin edition for ages 3 to 7: pronunciation, blending, tones and stroke tracing for all 37 symbols, everything unlocked with one purchase. No ads, no in-app purchase pop-ups, no sign-up and no internet required.

Parents page: check learning progress any time

Five games

  • Match and Feed: feed a companion the right sound
  • Magic Tracing: follow the strokes, learn the shapes
  • Tone Roller Coaster: hear the tones in motion
  • Bopomofo Fishing: listen to the blend, catch the right fish
  • Star Race: beat the clock and your own best score

Plus collectible companions, daily goals, achievement badges and weak-spot review.

Parents who don't read Zhuyin can still help

The interface comes in 50 languages, switchable inside the app (English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese and more) without changing the phone's language. Only the interface text changes; the child still learns Zhuyin. Big buttons and clear voice prompts let young children play on their own.

Privacy

  • Collects no personal data; progress stays on the child's device
  • The parents page lives on that device too; nothing is sent to teachers or to the developer
  • No ads, no outside links, no social features

My promise

Nothing is offered for recommendations, shares or ratings. Whether to mention the app to parents is the teacher's call.

A simple routine

  • After class introduces new symbols, parents give the child 10 minutes with the app that week
  • Before the next class, parents glance at the parents page and tell the teacher where the child got stuck
  • The app covers listening, tones and blending; handwriting homework stays on paper

Price

Buy once, use forever, share with the family. No subscription and no in-app purchases (price as shown in each country's App Store). To try first, the free Lumi Bopomofo lets families play the core games and unlock everything later with one purchase.
